consent.title: Location tracking consent
consent.description: Location tracking sends this driver's GPS position to dispatch and to customers viewing the public tracking link while a load is in transit. Tracking cannot start until the driver grants consent, and it stops immediately if consent is withdrawn.
consent.notGranted: Tracking consent has not been granted.
consent.revokeSuccess: Tracking consent revoked. Any open tracking sessions for this driver have been ended.
consent.ownActionOnly: A driver may only grant or revoke their own tracking consent.
consent.consentVersioned: Consent is given over a specific text. If that text changes, we ask again.
consent.onlyDriverCan: Only this driver can grant or withdraw it. Nobody can do it on their behalf.
consent.noLogin: This driver has no login, so they cannot grant consent — and without it they are not tracked.
consent.notLegalAdvice: This record is not a substitute for legal advice on what must be asked, and how, where you operate.

detail.mapNoProviderNote: No mapping provider is configured — showing a schematic of the stops in sequence instead.

errors.linkRevoked: This tracking link has been revoked.
errors.needsTwoStops: This load needs at least two stops before tracking can start.
errors.noDriverAssigned: This load has no driver assigned, so there is nobody to ask for consent and nobody to track.
errors.noOpenSession: There is no open tracking session for this load.
errors.publicTrackingDisabled: Public tracking links are disabled for this organization.
errors.routeNeedsTwoStops: A route needs at least two stops with coordinates.

errors.routeTollNotConfigured: No toll provider is configured — this estimate is unavailable rather than guessed.
errors.simulationNotAvailable: Simulated movement is only available for sessions on the mock tracking provider.
errors.stopAlreadyArrived: Arrival at this stop was already recorded.
errors.stopAlreadyDeparted: Departure from this stop was already recorded.
errors.stopNotArrivedYet: A departure cannot be recorded for a stop the truck is not recorded as having reached.
errors.stopNotFound: That stop does not belong to this load.
errors.trackingConsentMissing: Location tracking cannot start until the driver grants tracking consent.

integrations.description: Connections to external tracking, mapping, tolling, compliance and messaging providers. Categories marked "interface only" are wired into this application's code but are not yet connected to a live account this release.
integrations.interfaceOnlyBadge: Interface only — not connected this release
integrations.credentialsHint: Credentials are encrypted at rest and never shown again after saving.

testResult.interfaceOnly: This provider is not connected this release — its interface is implemented but no live account is wired up.
testResult.noCredentials: No credentials are saved for this provider, so its connection cannot be tested.
testResult.notVerifiable: This provider has no automated health check yet — saved credentials could not be verified.

publicLink.createSuccess: Tracking link created. Copy it now — it is not shown again.
publicLink.description: Share a link that lets a customer follow this load's progress without an account. Links expire automatically and can be revoked at any time.
publicLink.empty: No tracking links have been created for this load.
publicLink.neverSentWarning: This load is already on the road and the customer has not been sent the tracking link. The public site promises they receive it when the load is dispatched: send it from here.
publicLink.rawTokenWarning: This is the only time this link will be shown. Copy it before leaving this page.
publicLink.revokeConfirmBody: Anyone with this link will immediately lose access.
publicLink.sendFailed: The email could not be sent. The link exists: copy it and send it by hand.
publicLink.sendHint: A new link is created and sent to that address. The previous one keeps working until it expires or is revoked.

session.panelHint: Starting tracking opens the session and records the consent it was opened under. No GPS provider is connected today, so the positions you see are the ones dispatch records — each line says where it came from.
session.simulateHint: Development tool. It does not exist in production, and only appears while the mock tracking provider is active. It advances the simulated driver through the stop sequence — there is no route geometry to follow — and writes the events that become visible.
